title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Auritus
description:
**Problem**
Low-severity findings from the audit of Auritus (develop) and Auritus-web (main), one checklist line each.

**Evidence / Fix** (checklist)
- [ ] [Auritus-web] Docs link to a private Papyrus-web pull request; remove the link.
- [ ] 15 of 19 site pages share the same page title; give each page its own title.
- [ ] /pricing is orphaned (nothing links to it) and /pricing/ returns 404; link it or redirect it. See also auritus-91c840.
- [ ] cli tts backends bark.py:25 and coqui.py:24 carry "TODO verify API"; the backends are undocumented. Verify and document, or remove.

**How to verify**
Each box is checked by the grep or URL named in it; for example `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://aurit.us/pricing/` returns 200.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
